title: Rebuilding Pompeii
scene: 國家地理在馬爾他把龐貝城照原尺寸重建，用紀錄片加戲劇，重現火山爆發前最後 24 小時。

video.title: Nat Geo Rebuilt Pompeii To Scale | Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston | National Geographic

lines.en: In Pompeii, you can time travel.
lines.zh: 在龐貝，你可以穿越時空。

lines.en: So let’s go back to that day in A.D.
lines.zh: 所以我們回到西元
79 年的那一天。

lines.en: Action!
lines.zh: 開拍！

lines.en: This show is the story of the last 24 hours of the Roman city.
lines.zh: 這部節目講的是這座羅馬城市最後 24 小時的故事。

lines.en: This project is led by Tom Hiddleston, who is digging into the past to find remarkable stories.
lines.zh: 這個計畫由湯姆・希德斯頓帶領，他深入挖掘過去，尋找精彩的故事。

lines.en: Is there another way of looking at all this evidence?
lines.zh: 有沒有另一種方式來看這些證據？

lines.en: Is there another way of seeing the past?
lines.zh: 有沒有另一種方式來看過去？

lines.en: The project's genesis was very much from Tom's love of classical past, combined with love of storytelling.
lines.zh: 這個計畫的起點，很大程度來自湯姆對古典時代的熱愛，再加上他對說故事的熱愛。

lines.en: I'm going to try and trace three real Romans through this disaster.
lines.zh: 我要試著追蹤三個真實的羅馬人，看他們怎麼經歷這場災難。

lines.en: We are using two forms of filmmaking to tell one story.
lines.zh: 我們用兩種拍片方式來說同一個故事。

lines.en: Documentary.
lines.zh: 紀錄片。

lines.en: There seems to have been some sort of attempt of an evacuation.
lines.zh: 當時似乎有人試圖撤離。

lines.en: Something did happen on this beach.
lines.zh: 這片海灘上確實發生過什麼事。

lines.en: And drama to bring those experiences to life.
lines.zh: 還有戲劇，讓那些經歷活起來。

lines.en: This isn’t just an earthquake, is it?
lines.zh: 這不只是地震，對吧？

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 不是。

lines.en: This is something else.
lines.zh: 這是別的東西。

lines.en: Camera set.
lines.zh: 攝影機就位。

lines.en: Background action!
lines.zh: 背景演員動作！

lines.en: To do this ambitious project of bringing these people back, bringing their world back, we didn't want to be in a studio.
lines.zh: 要完成這個把這些人、把他們的世界帶回來的大計畫，我們不想待在攝影棚裡。

lines.en: We're in Malta because we had to rebuild Pompeii.
lines.zh: 我們在馬爾他，因為我們必須重建龐貝。

lines.en: The crews that we're working with are amazing, We have multiple builds, multiple streets that have to withstand flooding it
lines.zh: 合作的劇組人員都很厲害。我們有好幾個場景、好幾條街道，必須承受被灌滿

lines.en: with ash and volcanic bombs and explosions.
lines.zh: 火山灰、火山彈和爆炸。

lines.en: The street set that’s behind is literally millimeter accurate.
lines.zh: 後面這條街的場景，真的精準到毫米。

lines.en: Action!
lines.zh: 開拍！

lines.en: And then to put performers, and then to put the practical effects into it, then these people really come back to life.
lines.zh: 然後放進演員，再放進實景特效，這些人就真的活過來了。

lines.en: Inside, everyone!
lines.zh: 大家進去！

lines.en: Were doing it for real.
lines.zh: 我們是來真的。

lines.en: So all the pumice and the ash and the dust.
lines.zh: 所以有浮石、火山灰和塵土。

lines.en: Jumping over a statue whilst also having an air cannon blasting in your ears, that's quite fun.
lines.zh: 一邊跳過雕像，耳邊一邊有空氣砲在轟，滿好玩的。

lines.en: Avi!
lines.zh: Avi！

lines.en: You okay?
lines.zh: 你還好嗎？

lines.en: And it’s so much easier to get lost in it because it feels so real.
lines.zh: 因為感覺很真實，所以更容易投入其中。

lines.en: What we've created is really special, and a rare glimpse into what happened.
lines.zh: 我們做出來的東西很特別，讓人難得一窺當時發生了什麼。

lines.en: And get a bit of drama and storytelling too.
lines.zh: 也加上一點戲劇和故事。

lines.en: You find her.
lines.zh: 你去找她。

lines.en: Find us.
lines.zh: 來找我們。

lines.en: Go!
lines.zh: 快走！

lines.en: Here we are, two thousand years later, telling their story.
lines.zh: 兩千年後的現在，我們在這裡說他們的故事。

lines.en: I mean, it's as if his hand was holding it moments ago.
lines.zh: 我是說，就好像他的手剛剛還握著它一樣。

lines.en: We can shrink that gap of two thousand years and make people go, oh, this is what I would feel if I was going through
lines.zh: 我們可以縮短這兩千年的距離，讓人覺得：喔，如果我經歷

lines.en: a disaster like this.
lines.zh: 這樣的災難，就會是這種感覺。

lines.en: At its core, what we're trying to do is tell a story of tragedy, but a tragedy with hope.
lines.zh: 說到底，我們想說的是一個悲劇的故事，但是帶著希望的悲劇。

lines.en: Avi!
lines.zh: Avi！

lines.en: Showcasing to audiences a side of this story that they have never known to even expect.
lines.zh: 讓觀眾看到這個故事裡，他們從來沒想過會有的一面。

lines.en: They rescue one another.
lines.zh: 他們互相救援。

lines.en: Yes.
lines.zh: 是的。

lines.en: Everybody’s getting to safety!
lines.zh: 大家都在往安全的地方去！

lines.en: Come on!
lines.zh: 快來！

lines.en: By combining history and story, I found a fuller truth.
lines.zh: 把歷史和故事結合起來，我找到了更完整的真相。

lines.en: I know I found the people of Pompeii.
lines.zh: 我知道，我找到了龐貝的人們。

options: The building of a new Roman museum
The last 24 hours of the city of Pompeii
quiz.why: 影片一開始就說，這部節目講的是這座羅馬城市最後 24 小時的故事。

quiz.q: Why did they go to Malta?
quiz.why: 他們說在馬爾他，是因為必須把龐貝城重建出來，不想待在攝影棚。

quiz.q: How do they describe the story they want to tell?
options: A funny story about Roman food
A love story between two actors
A story about science and volcanoes only
A tragedy, but a tragedy with hope
quiz.why: 他們說核心是一個悲劇的故事，但是帶著希望的悲劇。
